name: Grok Bot TUI
author: pixbroker
description: Unofficial Omarchy bar widget for the native Rust Grok Bot TUI. Reads a pushed inbox snapshot. Click a row to open that bot in the Rust TUI. Does not launch the Electron app.

barWidget.description: Inbox of latest bot messages. Click a row to open that bot in the Rust TUI.

schema.label: Rust TUI command
schema.description: Must be grokbot-tui or an absolute path ending in /grokbot-tui. Never Electron /usr/bin/grokbot. Do not put tokens here.

schema.label: Terminal app id
schema.description: Omarchy TUI window id used when opening a bot from the panel.
